title: AI代理驱动云计算架构变革：基础设施深度融合与行业应用加速
core_insight: 云厂商正加速AI代理能力与基础设施的深度融合，从Kubernetes设备管理到边缘计算，形成新一代智能云架构，同时AI应用向核能、金融等关键行业深度渗透

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud推出基于MCP服务器的生产级AI代理构建方案和Kubernetes动态资源分配技术，显著提升GPU等稀缺资源调度效率；Cloudflare通过Dynamic Workers实现AI代码沙箱执行，速度提升100倍；AWS Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless实现秒级数据库创建 Cloudflare Gen 13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器，边缘计算性能翻倍；NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super登陆Amazon Bedrock；微软推进数据库与AI深度融合，Azure SQL集成AI能力 How to build production-ready AI agents with Google-managed MCP servers DRA: A new era of Kubernetes device management with Dynamic Resource Allocation Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Cloudflare推出自定义区域服务支持精确地理边界定义；AWS控制台新增可视化定制功能，支持按区域和服务选择性显示；微软在KubeCon Europe展示Kubernetes操作成熟度提升 Google Cloud通过五项技术优化LLM推理效率边界；Cloudflare Gen 13服务器采用高核数AMD EPYC Turin处理器，算力供应能力显著提升；AWS持续强化AI算力供应 Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control Customize your AWS Management Console experience with visual settings including account color, region and service visibility Five techniques to reach the efficient frontier of LLM inference Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance What's new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026
dimension_texts.application: 微软宣布核能AI合作项目，将AI技术应用于核能行业智能化转型；Salesforce展示AI代理在IT支持场景的应用，40%支持案例由AI代理处理；火山引擎推动AI Agent在办公协作、图像视频生成等企业场景规模化应用 企业AI应用案例丰富，涵盖滑雪度假村个性化推荐、物流路径优化、金融贷款生命周期管理等场景；微软推出首个端到端现代化代理解决方案，连接IT与开发工作流 AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future How Salesforce Built, Tested, and Scaled Our IT Support Agents Easy as a green run: How Vail Resorts built an AI assistant to automate personalized recommendations How FM Logistic tackled the traveling salesman problem at warehouse scale with AlphaEvolve Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure OpenClaw × 豆包模型：构建图像与视频生成Skills实践
dimension_texts.capital: Physical Intelligence洽谈10亿美元融资，估值可能在4个月内翻倍至56亿美元；Strella完成1400万美元A轮融资，其AI访谈技术获亚马逊和Chobani采用 Anthropic的Claude付费用户快速增长，市场对AI公司估值保持高度关注 Salesforce与Adyen推出原生支付集成，强化电商生态能力；大厂主要通过技术合作和生态建设推进AI战略 Physical Intelligence is reportedly in talks to raise $1 billion, again Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M Anthropic’s Claude popularity with paying consumers is skyrocketing Keep your partner, lose the complexity: Introducing Salesforce’s native integration with Adyen
